trend.en: And I think this trend is a response to burnout and modern working cultures.
trend.zh: 我认为这种趋势是对职业倦怠和现代工作文化的一种回应。

trend.en: These social media influencers do what they're famous for: influencing and creating trends.
trend.zh: 这些社交媒体网红做着他们成名的事：影响并创造趋势。

trend.en: This word attempts to capture the mood, trends and changes in our society.
trend.zh: 这个词试图捕捉我们社会的士气、趋势和变化。

trend.en: But now, a new trend called rage bait is spreading across social media.
trend.zh: 但现在，一种名为“愤怒诱饵”的新趋势正在社交媒体上蔓延。

trend.en: The competition is fierce, and trends in the perfume industry change rapidly.
trend.zh: 竞争异常激烈，香水行业的潮流瞬息万变。

traditional.en: The pessimistic view is that we're not in a traditional bubble waiting to pop.
traditional.zh: 悲观的看法是，我们并不是身处一个等待破裂的传统泡沫中。

traditional.en: A traditional definition of corruption is the abuse of public office for personal gain.
traditional.zh: 对腐败的一个传统定义是：滥用公权力以谋取私利。

traditional.en: He trained his men in modern European military tactics rather than traditional Irish methods.
traditional.zh: 他用现代欧洲军事战术而非传统的爱尔兰方法训练部下。

traditional.en: Unlike other traditional food such as sushi, modern versions of ramen push the boundaries.
traditional.zh: 不像寿司等其他传统食物，现代版本的拉面在不断突破极限。

traditional.en: Number 10 Downing Street is the traditional home of the prime ministers in Central London.
traditional.zh: 唐宁街10号是伦敦市中心首相的传统住所。

tropical.en: It is a tropical and volcanic island known for its mountains and forests and volcanoes.
tropical.zh: 这是一座热带火山岛，以其山脉、森林和火山而闻名。

tropical.en: It has tropical rainforests, coral reefs, and also that famous red crab migration.
tropical.zh: 这里有热带雨林、珊瑚礁，还有那著名的红蟹大迁徙。

tropical.en: The city is in between mountains and tropical rainforests and the Atlantic Ocean.
tropical.zh: 这座城市夹在山脉、热带雨林和大西洋之间。

tropical.en: There are dense forests, incredibly hot deserts, tropical wetlands and temperate planes.
tropical.zh: 这里有茂密的森林、酷热的沙漠、热带湿地和温带平原。

tropical.en: Plus, his legendary resistance to tropical disease seemed to be weakening.
tropical.zh: 此外，他那对热带疾病的传奇抵抗力似乎也在减弱。

truth.en: And I would argue that that introspection to find those truths is actually very useful.
truth.zh: 我会说，那种寻找真相的内省实际上是非常有用的。

truth.en: For many voters in the UK, the emotional appeal outweighed the actual truth.
truth.zh: 对于英国的许多选民来说，情感诉求胜过了真正的真相。

truth.en: Despite the countless expeditions launched to uncover the truth, Fawcett’s remains have never been identified.
truth.zh: 尽管为了揭开真相发起了无数次远征，Fawcett 的遗骸却从未被确认过。

truth.en: And that is very hard truth to swallow and hard to get away from.
truth.zh: 这是一个很难接受的残酷真相，也很难摆脱。

truth.en: As a result, truth itself seems less influential than emotion or personal belief.
truth.zh: 因此，比起事实或个人信念，真相本身似乎失去了影响力。

traffic.en: I get off at 5. It was, like, maybe a 10-mile drive, busy traffic area.
traffic.zh: 我5点下班。大概有10英里的车程，交通非常拥挤。

traffic.en: Some ancient artefacts being sold online and in stores have been looted and trafficked.
traffic.zh: 一些在网上和商店里出售的古代文物是被掠夺和走私得来的。

traffic.en: I didn’t really know the vocabulary for terms like lanes or mirrors or traffic laws.
traffic.zh: 我真的不知道车道、后视镜或交通法规等术语怎么说。

traffic.en: Either way, the content creates interest, increases internet traffic and makes money for the creator.
traffic.zh: 无论哪种方式，这些内容都会产生关注度，增加网络流量，并为创作者赚钱。

traffic.en: Japanese traffic laws, of course, are full of specialized terms and legal phrasing.
traffic.zh: 当然，日本的交通法规充满了专业术语和法律措辞。

trap.en: Countries that don’t do this will be trapped in cycles of dependence and instability.
trap.zh: 不这样做的国家将陷入依赖与动荡的循环之中。

trap.en: Each problem reinforces the next, making escape from the poverty trap difficult.
trap.zh: 每个问题都在加剧下一个问题，使得摆脱贫困陷阱变得困难重重。

trap.en: This week - how we get in - and out - of the scarcity trap.
trap.zh: 本周——我们如何陷入——以及摆脱——稀缺陷阱。

trap.en: Yet unfortunately, due to economic or emotional reasons, many people stay trapped.
trap.zh: 然而不幸的是，由于经济或情感原因，许多人仍然被困在其中。

trap.en: When we come back, how the scarcity trap changes the way we think.
trap.zh: 休息之后，我们将探讨稀缺陷阱是如何改变我们的思维方式的。

treat.en: The North Korean government said he was being treated well and receiving medical care.
treat.zh: 朝鲜政府说他受到了良好的对待，也得到了医疗照顾。

treat.en: And the reason this was treated as a serious crime was not simply religious.
treat.zh: 这种行为被当作严重罪行处理，原因不仅仅是宗教方面的。

treat.en: In 2009, the British government issued an official apology for the way he had been treated.
treat.zh: 2009 年，英国政府就他所受到的不公正对待发表了官方道歉。

treat.en: If you normalise something, you treat it as normal or acceptable when previously it wasn't.
treat.zh: 如果你将某事常规化，你就会在以前不被接受的时候，把它当作正常或可接受的事情来对待。

treat.en: What would it mean if I treated this pursuit like an athlete does?
treat.zh: 如果我像运动员那样对待这个追求，意味着什么？

training.en: These are jobs that require training and experience, but not necessarily a university degree.
training.zh: 这些工作需要培训和经验，但不一定需要大学学位。

training.en: Life being one protracted training montage is a really important lesson to learn.
training.zh: 把生活看作一个漫长的训练蒙太奇是一个非常重要的教训。

training.en: Might be coaching, might be doing some training, might be working on a construction site.
training.zh: 可能是当教练，做点训练，或者在建筑工地干活。

training.en: You have done this in training, so you know you have the ability.
training.zh: 你在训练中做到过这一点，所以你知道自己具备这种能力。

training.en: As we'll hear, it's an extremely demanding sport which requires discipline, stamina and years of training.
training.zh: 正如我们将要听到的，这是一项要求极高的运动，需要自律、耐力和多年的训练。

transportation.en: Decisions made by oil-producing countries affect inflation, transportation, food prices, and our everyday lives.
transportation.zh: 产油国做出的决定会影响通货膨胀、交通运输、食品价格以及我们的日常生活。

transportation.en: Factories, transportation, and entire industries had been relying on cheap oil, but now costs were skyrocketing.
transportation.zh: 工厂、交通运输和整个工业都一直依赖廉价石油，但现在成本正在急剧飙升。

transportation.en: This includes things like defence, foreign aid, transportation and education.
transportation.zh: 这包括国防、对外援助、交通和教育等方面。

transportation.en: I'm - you know, it's just the transportation is not reliable.
transportation.zh: 我——你知道的，只是交通不太可靠。

transportation.en: Higher energy prices will mean higher transportation costs.
transportation.zh: 更高的能源价格将意味着更高的运输成本。

transport.en: Transporting stone and building large temples in such a difficult environment is a challenge.
transport.zh: 在如此困难的环境中运输石头并建造大型寺庙是一个巨大的挑战。

transport.en: Historians estimate that roughly 40% of all Africans transported across the Atlantic arrived in Brazil.
transport.zh: 历史学家估计，所有横渡大西洋被运送的非洲人中，大约有40%到达了巴西。

transport.en: I can feel the music. and I can be transported by the music.
transport.zh: 我能感受到音乐，也能被音乐带走。

transport.en: Today, we think of roads or railways as the main ways to transport people and goods.
transport.zh: 今天，我们认为公路或铁路是运输人员和货物的主要方式。

transport.en: The Incas didn’t have iron tools or wheeled transport, but they still created these incredible cities.
transport.zh: 印加人没有铁器工具或轮式运输工具，但他们仍然创造了这些不可思议的城市。

track.en: There are also refocusing questions, which are really useful when a discussion goes off track.
track.zh: 还有重新聚焦类问题，当讨论偏离正题时，这类问题真的非常有用。

track.en: Ancient people used writing to track things like their taxes, trade, supplies, property.
track.zh: 古代人们用文字来追踪税收、贸易、物资、财产等事情。

track.en: He also attempted to end his own life by jumping onto train tracks in London.
track.zh: 他甚至曾试图跳入伦敦的火车轨道来结束自己的生命。

track.en: All right, so what kind of background was typical for the American-born players that you’re tracking?
track.zh: 好吧，那么你所追踪的美国本土球员通常都有什么样的背景？

track.en: He instinctively knows the rhythm, structure, tone, and energy of the track without needing to think.
track.zh: 他无需思考，就能本能地知道该曲目的节奏、结构、音调和能量。

trigger.en: Actually, Taylor Swift's Edinburgh show wasn't the first music concert to trigger seismic waves.
trigger.zh: 事实上，Taylor Swift的爱丁堡演出并不是第一场引发地震波的音乐会。

trigger.en: I only really learned about myself in this context through my triggers as an adult.
trigger.zh: 不，我们只是在经历一个不安全的环境。

trigger.en: It may well have intensified his fear, agitation and confusion, and triggered further manic episodes.
trigger.zh: 这很可能加剧了他的恐惧、焦虑和困惑，并引发了进一步的躁狂发作。

trigger.en: By stepping down, by quitting, he triggered a by-election in the constituency of Makerfield near Manchester.
trigger.zh: 通过辞职，他引发了曼彻斯特附近马克菲尔德（Makerfield）选区的补选。

trigger.en: Like, yes, it's going to trigger you, but observe for a moment that like, it's triggering me.
trigger.zh: 没错，这些确实会触发你的情绪，但请观察片刻，意识到“这正在触发我的情绪”。

trust.en: Confidence is the trust that you will be able to cope if anything goes wrong.
trust.zh: 自信就是坚信如果出了什么差错，自己也能够应付。

trust.en: An erosion of trust happens when people gradually lose confidence in political and economic institutions.
trust.zh: 当人们对政治和经济机构的信心逐渐丧失时，就会发生信任流失（erosion of trust）。

trust.en: Trust us. Follow our instructions. The shock generator the teacher was shown looked convincing.
trust.zh: 相信我们，照我们说的做。“教师”看到的电击发生器，外观十分逼真可信。

trust.en: The colonists were given every reason to stop trusting the intentions of the British Parliament.
trust.zh: 殖民地有充分的理由不再信任英国议会的意图。

trust.en: When people no longer know who to trust, they are more vulnerable to post-truth thinking.
trust.zh: 当人们不再知道该信任谁时，他们就更容易受到后真相思维的影响。

transaction.en: We're setting you up to lie. Something about that transaction feels very wrong.
transaction.zh: 我们在诱导你们撒谎。这种交易感觉非常不对劲。

transaction.en: Basket spend is what you spend in one transaction on the things in your shopping basket.
transaction.zh: “客单价”是指你在一次交易中花在购物篮里物品上的钱。

transaction.en: Card transactions could be traced, as they were linked to your identity.
transaction.zh: 银行卡交易是可以被追踪的，因为它们与你的身份绑定。

transaction.en: A basket spend is the total amount that someone spends in one transaction, on everything that's in their basket.
transaction.zh: 客单价是指一个人在一次交易中，花在篮子里所有东西上的总金额。

transaction.en: But your friendships are one of the few relationships that don't necessarily rely on like a transaction in a way.
transaction.zh: 但你的友谊是少数不一定依赖于某种交易的关系之一。

translate.en: Or, if you were being particularly uncharitable, you might translate it as… “big nose.”
translate.zh: 或者，如果你特别刻薄的话，你也可以把它翻译成……“大鼻子”。

translate.en: It has been translated into hundreds of languages and sent around the world for centuries.
translate.zh: 它已经被翻译成了数百种语言，几个世纪以来被分发到世界各地。

translate.en: They took him to other European cities, where his name was tweaked or translated.
translate.zh: 他们又把他带到其他欧洲城市，他的名字也随之被微调或翻译。

translate.en: But once books are translated into dozens or hundreds of languages, they can spread globally.
translate.zh: 但一旦书籍被翻译成几十种或上百种语言，它们就能在全球范围内传播。

translate.en: You can’t always, or really you can never, translate them word for word.
translate.zh: 你不能总是——或者说实际上你永远不能——逐字翻译它们。

tractor.en: Carbon emissions from food production make up around a third of all greenhouse gases, from the diesel used to drive tractors, to fertilisers, to cows and sheep producing methane.
tractor.zh: 粮食生产产生的碳排放约占所有温室气体的三分之一，从驱动拖拉机的柴油、化肥，到产生甲烷的牛羊。

trial.en: The case went to trial at the Old Bailey, England's most famous criminal court.
trial.zh: 此案在英国最著名的刑事法院 Old Bailey 开庭审理。

trial.en: No trial. This was the “Wild” West, but even here, this crossed a line.
trial.zh: 没有审判。这里是“狂野”的西部，但即便如此，这也已经越过了底线。

trial.en: OK then, let’s step into the icy, unsettling world of the Salem Witch Trials.
trial.zh: 好了，让我们走进塞勒姆审巫案那冰冷、令人不安的世界吧。

trial.en: The year is 1961. It is April, and in Jerusalem, a trial has just begun.
trial.zh: 时间是1961年4月，在耶路撒冷，一场审判刚刚开始。

trial.en: OK then, that is it for today's episode on the Salem Witch Trials.
trial.zh: 好了，今天关于塞勒姆审巫案的节目就到这里。

truly.en: From that point on, the honeymoon period of Caligula’s reign was well and truly over.
truly.zh: 从那时起，Caligula 统治的蜜月期彻底结束了。

truly.en: That's when you can truly be whatever the fuck you want to be.
truly.zh: 那时候你可以真正成为你想成为的任何该死的人。

truly.en: By 11 pm that evening, the tide had well and truly turned.
truly.zh: 到了当晚11点，局势彻底逆转。

truly.en: If you truly love what you do, they couldn't pay you to stop.
truly.zh: 如果你真的热爱你所做的事，他们花钱也无法让你停下来。

truly.en: To truly survive in the modern world, Turkey had to change.
truly.zh: 为了在现代世界中真正生存下去，土耳其必须改变。

trace.en: You can trace modern China back to the same China that existed 2000 or 3000 years ago.
trace.zh: 你可以将现代中国追溯到2000或3000年前存在的那个中国。

trace.en: To trace something back to something is to find out where something has come from.
trace.zh: 将某物追溯到某处（trace something back to something）是指找出某物的来源。

trace.en: To trace something back to something, means to find out where something has come from.
trace.zh: 将某物追溯到某处（trace something back to something），意思是找出某物的来源。

trace.en: Card transactions could be traced, as they were linked to your identity.
trace.zh: 银行卡交易是可以被追踪的，因为它们与你的身份绑定。

trace.en: Luckily, some companies now offer to trace your ancestry using DNA.
trace.zh: 幸运的是，现在一些公司提供利用DNA来追溯祖先的服务。

trick.en: She said she’d been tricked–by the devil, she claimed–and hadn’t meant to hurt anyone.
trick.zh: 她说自己当时受了蛊惑——她声称是魔鬼干的——并不是故意要伤害任何人。

trick.en: The reason that this trick works is that people spend 10 days, they become a part of the family.
trick.zh: 这个把戏之所以管用，是因为人们花了10天时间，他们成为了这个大家庭的一部分。

trick.en: A hangman comes to execute Punch. Punch tricks the hangman into putting his own head in the noose.
trick.zh: 一个刽子手来处决 Punch。Punch 诱骗刽子手把自己的头套进套索里。

trick.en: His tricks were clever: he could send ‘ spectres,’ invisible spirits, to pinch or choke you in the night.
trick.zh: 他的伎俩非常高明：他可以派遣“幽灵”（即无形的精魂）在夜里掐你或勒你。

trick.en: It's not real. I mean, you're not going to trick them.
trick.zh: 那不是真的。我的意思是，你骗不了他们。

transform.en: Under Ottoman rule, Istanbul was also transformed into a Muslim cultural and political centre.
transform.zh: 在奥斯曼帝国的统治下，伊斯坦布尔也被改造为一个穆斯林文化和政治中心。

transform.en: The discovery of phosphate on Christmas Island transformed the island into an economic resource.
transform.zh: 圣诞岛上磷酸盐的发现使该岛变成了经济资源。

transform.en: Grand buildings and palaces, and public spaces were built, and they transformed the city’s appearance.
transform.zh: 宏伟的建筑、宫殿和公共空间拔地而起，改变了城市的风貌。

transform.en: Soon after democracy was dismantled, destroyed, and Germany was transformed into a totalitarian state.
transform.zh: 不久之后，民主被拆除、摧毁，德国被改造为一个极权国家。

transform.en: Very few scientific ideas have transformed our understanding of the world so completely.
transform.zh: 很少有科学思想能如此彻底地改变我们对世界的理解。

trade.en: Brazil was the number one recipient of African slaves from the transatlantic slave trade.
trade.zh: 巴西是跨大西洋奴隶贸易中接收非洲奴隶最多的国家。

trade.en: Britain and the Netherlands, in particular, were competing for influence over the region’s trade.
trade.zh: 尤其是英国和荷兰，在争夺该地区贸易的影响力。

trade.en: And then finally, the final interesting political word I’ll introduce today, is horse trading.
trade.zh: 最后，我要介绍的最后一个有趣的政治词汇是“幕后交易”（horse trading）。

trade.en: Vancouver is a place of technology and film production and international trade with Asia.
trade.zh: 温哥华则是科技、影视制作以及与亚洲开展国际贸易的重镇。

trade.en: It was also easier to defend and better connected to major trade routes than Rome.
trade.zh: 与罗马相比，它也更容易防守，并且与主要贸易路线连接得更好。

tradition.en: China has thousands of years of recognizable cultural tradition and language and historical records.
tradition.zh: 中国拥有数千年可识别的文化传统、语言和历史记载。

tradition.en: So, what we are going to do today is talk about this tradition.
tradition.zh: 所以今天我们要聊的，就是这项传统。

tradition.en: Now, at Christmas people often create family traditions that they repeat every year.
tradition.zh: 现在，在圣诞节，人们经常会创立每年重复的家庭传统。

tradition.en: And Claudia likes this tradition, imagining the children waiting on the stairs, dying for their presents.
tradition.zh: Claudia 很喜欢这个传统，想象着孩子们在楼梯上等待，渴望得到他们的礼物。

tradition.en: Many in Turkey, particularly in the countryside, saw these reforms as an attack on their traditions.
tradition.zh: 土耳其的许多人，尤其是乡间的人，将这些改革视为对他们传统的攻击。

treatment.en: Things had gotten so bad, she had to go to a residential treatment center.
treatment.zh: 情况变得如此糟糕，她不得不去了一家住宅式治疗中心。

treatment.en: And radiology, including cancer treatments, radiotherapy, ways to kill cancer inside your body.
treatment.zh: 还有放射学，包括癌症治疗、放射疗法以及消灭体内癌细胞的方法。

treatment.en: We'll look at his illness, and the treatments that were almost certainly making him worse.
treatment.zh: 我们来看看他的病情，以及那些几乎肯定让他病情加重的治疗方法。

treatment.en: He tried to negotiate with France for medical treatment, but they refused.
treatment.zh: 他试图与法国协商医疗救治，但遭到拒绝。

treatment.en: So a lot of treatments are just outright banned by large regulatory bodies.
treatment.zh: 所以很多疗法直接被大型监管机构禁止了。

treasure.en: Well, as the final destination for much looted treasure, museums have an important role to play.
treasure.zh: 嗯，作为许多被掠夺宝藏的最终目的地，博物馆扮演着重要的角色。

treasure.en: Hardy later said that reading Ramanujan’s work was like “opening a treasure chest full of mathematical jewels.”
treasure.zh: Hardy后来评价说，阅读Ramanujan的作品就像是“打开了一个装满数学珍宝的宝箱。”

treasure.en: So choosing the right path, the right project, the right job or passion or religion — that’s where the treasure lies; that’s where the value lies.
treasure.zh: 所以选择正确的道路、正确的项目、正确的工作、激情或宗教——这才是宝藏所在；这才是价值所在。

treasure.en: By this point in time, there were hundreds of known shipwrecks with valuable treasure, from ancient Roman shipwrecks through to ships that had only sunk the previous year.
treasure.zh: 到这个时候，有数百艘已知的沉船携带着宝贵的财富，从古罗马沉船到刚刚在前一年沉没的船只。

treasure.en: However, Guglielmo de Lorena invented a device that allowed him to spend hours at a time exploring the ships, meaning he could return to the surface with treasures from ancient Rome.
treasure.zh: 然而，古列尔莫·德洛雷纳发明了一种装置，使他能够一次花上几个小时探索这些船只，这意味着他可以带着古罗马的宝藏浮出水面。

transmit.en: That then gets transmitted to the middle ear.
transmit.zh: 然后这些声音被传输到中耳。

transmit.en: Once in the middle ear, the eardrum amplifies the sounds before transmitting them to tiny hairs in the inner ear, which then sends electrical signals to the brain.
transmit.zh: 一旦进入中耳，耳膜就会放大声音，然后将其传输到内耳的微小毛细胞，最后毛细胞向大脑发送电信号。

transmit.en: Is that a justification for more experimentation, exploration, experience in life, sort of trying to find serendipity because all of these experiences are going to teach you an inescapable lesson? you're going to do what you're going to do i mean your level of exploration i think is sort of up to you but life is always throwing truth back at you uh it's about whether you choose to see it whether you choose to acknowledge it uh even if it's painful truth is often painful right if it wasn't we'd all be seeing truth all the time reality is always reflecting truth that's all it is why would you not have accessed it already exactly uh you know all the all the philosophy that's out there for example uh it's almost trite like most people they look at philosophy like until they discover it for themselves and because because wisdom is the set of things that that cannot be transmitted if they could be transmitted you know we'd read the same five philosophy books it would all be done we'd all be wise you have to learn it for yourself it has to be rediscovered for yourself in your own context you have to have specific experiences that then allow you to generalize and see the truth in those things in such a way that you're not going to unsee them.
transmit.zh: 这是否证明了在生活中进行更多实验、探索、体验的合理性，比如试图寻找机缘巧合，因为所有这些经历都会给你上一堂不可避免的课？你会做你该做的事，我的意思是，你的探索程度取决于你自己，但生活总是不断地把真相抛向你，关键在于你是否选择去看，是否选择去承认，即使它是痛苦的。真相往往是痛苦的，对吧？如果不是这样，我们早就看清一切了。现实总是反映真相，仅此而已。为什么你还没有接触到它？完全正确。你知道，所有现存的哲学，举个例子，几乎都是陈词滥调，大多数人看待哲学，直到他们自己发现它，因为智慧是一套无法被传授的东西，如果它们能被传授，我们读同样的五本哲学书就够了，一切都完成了，我们都会变得睿智。你必须自己去学习，它必须在你自己的语境中被重新发现。你必须有特定的经历，然后这些经历让你能够概括并看清其中的真相，以至于你无法再假装看不见。

transmit.en: Is that a justification for more experimentation, exploration, experience in life, sort of trying to find serendipity because all of these experiences are going to teach you an inescapable lesson? you're going to do what you're going to do i mean your level of exploration i think is sort of up to you but life is always throwing truth back at you uh it's about whether you choose to see it whether you choose to acknowledge it uh even if it's painful truth is often painful right if it wasn't we'd all be seeing truth all the time reality is always reflecting truth that's all it is why would you not have accessed it already exactly uh you know all the all the philosophy that's out there for example uh it's almost trite like most people they look at philosophy like until they discover it for themselves and because because wisdom is the set of things that that cannot be transmitted if they could be transmitted you know we'd read the same five philosophy books it would all be done we'd all be wise you have to learn it for yourself it has to be rediscovered for yourself in your own context you have to have specific experiences that then allow you to generalize and see the truth in those things in such a way that you're not going to unsee them.
transmit.zh: 这是否证明了在生活中进行更多实验、探索、体验的合理性，比如试图寻找机缘巧合，因为所有这些经历都会给你上一堂不可避免的课？你会做你该做的事，我的意思是，你的探索程度取决于你自己，但生活总是不断地把真相抛向你，关键在于你是否选择去看，是否选择去承认，即使它是痛苦的。真相往往是痛苦的，对吧？如果不是这样，我们早就看清一切了。现实总是反映真相，仅此而已。为什么你还没有接触到它？完全正确。你知道，所有现存的哲学，举个例子，几乎都是陈词滥调，大多数人看待哲学，直到他们自己发现它，因为智慧是一套无法被传授的东西，如果它们能被传授，我们读同样的五本哲学书就够了，一切都完成了，我们都会变得睿智。你必须自己去学习，它必须在你自己的语境中被重新发现。你必须有特定的经历，然后这些经历让你能够概括并看清其中的真相，以至于你无法再假装看不见。

tribe.en: Then there were the Gauls, the recently conquered or allied tribes from southern France.
tribe.zh: 还有高卢人，也就是刚刚被征服或归附的法国南部部落。

tribe.en: Let's return to Afia Pokua, the journalist who criticised the King of the Ashanti tribe.
tribe.zh: 让我们回到阿菲娅·波库阿，那个批评阿香提部落国王的记者。

tribe.en: Many of the tribes and cities that had been brought under Roman control were not especially loyal.
tribe.zh: 许多被纳入罗马统治之下的部落和城市其实并不算忠诚。

tribe.en: So for example, earned respect in the tribe is you do things that are good for the tribe.
tribe.zh: 比如，在部落里赢得尊重，就是去做对部落有益的事。

tribe.en: So for example, earned respect in the tribe is you do things that are good for the tribe.
tribe.zh: 比如，在部落里赢得尊重，就是去做对部落有益的事。

trader.en: French traders realized they could make a really good income from the fur trade.
trader.zh: 法国商人意识到，通过毛皮贸易，他们可以获得相当丰厚的收入。

trader.en: From their origins, probably somewhere in China, noodle recipes were spread by traders on the ancient Silk Road.
trader.zh: 从它们的起源来看——可能在中国的某个地方，面条的制作方法是通过古代丝绸之路上的商人们传播开来的。

trader.en: But for a long time, Warsaw was just a modest community of fishermen and traders living behind the Vistula River.
trader.zh: 但在很长一段时间里，华沙只是维斯瓦河畔一个简朴的渔民和商人社区。

trader.en: This was a strategic location that allowed merchants to transport goods and local leaders to collect taxes from passing traders.
trader.zh: 这是一个战略要地，使商人能够运输货物，当地领袖能够向过往的商人征税。

trader.en: Traders and settlers landed and made their bases over the years, and in 1886, France took formal control of the islands.
trader.zh: 多年来，商人和平民定居者陆续登陆并建立基地。1886年，法国正式控制了这些岛屿。

trample.en: What's more, by wandering freely around the forest they trample down dead trees, reducing the amount of flammable, meaning easily burned, vegetation.
trample.zh: 此外，它们在森林里自由漫步的同时，还会踩倒枯树，从而减少易燃(flammable，即容易着火)的植被数量。

trample.en: Along with the cows' voracious appetite, they trample on the vegetation, and it's that trampling that helps to open up the forest so it's not so densely packed full of flammable vegetation.
trample.zh: 这些牛不仅食欲旺盛，还会踩踏植被，正是这种踩踏(trampling)有助于让森林变得疏朗，不再挤满易燃的植被。

tremble.en: They sweated, trembled, and begged the experimenter to let them stop.
tremble.zh: 他们汗流浃背，浑身颤抖，恳求主试者让他们停下来。

tragedy.en: So, it's a tragedy that a man of that talent had to devote so much of it to being allowed to do what he could do.
tragedy.zh: 所以说，这真是一场悲剧——一个如此有才华的人，竟不得不把大量才干耗费在“争取获准去做他本可以做的事”这件事本身上。

tragedy.en: The book was illustrated by a celebrated caricaturist and it was given a wonderful title: "The Tragical Comedy or Comical Tragedy of Punch and Judy".
tragedy.zh: 这本书由一位著名的漫画家配图，并有一个绝妙的书名：《Punch and Judy 的悲喜剧或滑稽悲剧》。

tragedy.en: However, tragedy struck. Germanicus, this heroic military leader who seemed poised to become the next emperor, died suddenly in Syria in AD 19, at the age of 33.
tragedy.zh: 然而，悲剧降临了。Germanicus 这位似乎注定要成为下一任皇帝的英雄军事统帅，于公元19年在叙利亚突然去世，享年33岁。

tragedy.en: And when he sees great tragedy in the world, like an earthquake, a school shooting, or a hate-filled attack on an Orlando nightclub, his mind goes immediately to prophecy that was drilled into him from an early age.
tragedy.zh: 当他看到世上的巨大悲剧时，比如地震、校园枪击案，或者对奥兰多夜总会的仇恨袭击，他的脑海里就会立刻浮现出从小就被灌输的预言。

transition.en: It’s a life changing transition. And I want to, kind of, face it with balance and patience.
transition.zh: 这是一次改变人生的过渡。我希望以平衡和耐心的心态去面对它。

transition.en: Britain transitioned from an agrarian, farming-based economy, to an industrial one.
transition.zh: 英国从以农业为基础的经济体转变为工业经济体。

transition.en: What actually happened, though, was less a smooth technocratic transition and more a chaotic power vacuum.
transition.zh: 然而，实际发生的情况与其说是一个平稳的技术官僚过渡，不如说是一个混乱的权力真空。

transition.en: You just have to read it. I was there for that transition.
transition.zh: 你只需要读它就行。我经历过那个过渡期。

transition.en: But Justin is trying to make it easier on the players to quit and to make that transition.
transition.zh: 但贾斯汀正在努力让球员更容易放弃并完成这种转型。

transformation.en: Another important development in British food recently has been the transformation of the pub.
transformation.zh: 最近英国食物的另一个重要发展是酒吧的转型。

transformation.en: He had fought for Turkey’s independence, but now he would fight for its transformation.
transformation.zh: 他为土耳其的独立而战，但现在他要为土耳其的转型而战。

transformation.en: One of the biggest transformations came with the rise of the internet and social media.
transformation.zh: 其中最大的变革之一伴随着互联网和社交媒体的兴起而到来。

transformation.en: What followed was the fastest transformation of human life in the entire million-year story of fire.
transformation.zh: 随之而来的是火的百万年历史中人类生活最快的转变。

transformation.en: So chimpanzees understand the transformation, from raw to cooked food.
transformation.zh: 所以黑猩猩理解从生食到熟食的转变。

troop.en: They weren’t as heavily armoured as the Roman troops, but they were bold and adaptable.
troop.zh: 他们的盔甲没有罗马军队那么厚重，但他们勇敢且适应力极强。

troop.en: At one point, it was reported that Blackwater personnel outnumbered American troops in some regions of Iraq.
troop.zh: 据报道，在伊拉克某些地区，黑水公司人员的数量一度超过了美军。

troop.en: There were foreign troops from the United Nations, Belgian commandos, and even Cuban advisors in the mix.
troop.zh: 其中还夹杂着来自联合国的外国军队、比利时突击队员，甚至还有古巴顾问。

troop.en: He became more ruthless in battle. He authorised brutal reprisals against Ottoman troops, including the execution of prisoners.
troop.zh: 他在战斗中变得更加冷酷无情。他授权对奥斯曼军队进行残暴的报复，包括处决战俘。

troop.en: So Napoleon invaded Portugal. As Napoleon’s troops marched towards Lisbon in late 1807, Portugal’s royal family chose to escape.
troop.zh: 于是拿破仑入侵了葡萄牙。随着拿破仑的军队在1807年底向里斯本进军，葡萄牙王室选择逃亡。

trail.en: The most recent polls have him with a 45% chance of becoming the Republican nominee, with Donald Trump Jr trailing behind at 17%.
trail.zh: 最近的民调显示，他有45%的概率成为共和党总统候选人，而小唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump Jr）以17%的支持率紧随其后。

trail.en: On the campaign trail, he had promised Libertarian voters that he would free Ulbricht, and on the day he announced it, he posted that, “the scum that worked to convict him were some of the same lunatics who were involved in the modern-day weaponisation of government against me”
trail.zh: 在竞选期间，他曾向自由意志主义选民承诺他会释放 Ulbricht。在他宣布这一消息的当天，他发帖称：“那些致力于定他罪的败类，与参与现代政府针对我的武器化行动的疯子是同一伙人。”

trail.en: At the same time, I think I was fooling myself a little bit in thinking that young teenage boys would drop everything when their father came home and say, “Oh dad it’s great to have you, let’s play!” No, they were very happy to have me there but then they said, “But dad, we’re going off with our friends.” So, I kind of would trail around after them a little bit with my metaphoric tail between my legs and try to, you know, well say, “Wouldn’t you like to play?
trail.zh: 与此同时，我认为自己有点自欺欺人，以为十几岁的男孩子会在父亲回家时放下手头的一切，然后说：“哦，爸爸，有你太棒了，我们玩吧！”不，他们很高兴我在那儿，但接着他们会说：“但是爸爸，我们要和朋友们出去了。”所以，我有点像夹着尾巴（寓意上）跟在他们后面晃悠，然后试着，你知道的，就说：“你们不想玩吗？

tragic.en: One of the most tragic consequences of the wall was how it divided families and communities.
tragic.zh: 这堵墙最悲惨的后果之一是它如何分裂了家庭和社区。

tragic.en: Some, like Theodore Roosevelt, ascended to the presidency after a tragic assassination, while others, like George H.W.
tragic.zh: 其中一些人，比如西奥多·罗斯福，是在一场悲剧性的刺杀后登上总统宝座的；而另一些人，比如老乔治·H·W·

tragic.en: But on the way home, Theseus made a tragic mistake.
tragic.zh: 但在回家的路上，忒修斯犯了一个悲惨的错误。

tragic.en: But history of city is dramatic and tragic.
tragic.zh: 但这座城市的历史却充满戏剧性与悲剧色彩。

tragic.en: But that same year, political tensions erupted in the tragic Tlatelolco massacre, when government forces killed student protestors.
tragic.zh: 但在同一年，政治紧张局势在悲惨的特拉特洛尔科大屠杀中爆发，当时政府军队杀害了学生抗议者。

triumphant.en: He arrived, sunburned, half-starved, and covered in dust, but triumphant.
triumphant.zh: 他到达时，皮肤被晒伤，半饥半饱，满身尘土，但凯旋而归。

triumphant.en: So, he returns not in the clothes of a triumphant king, but disguised as a poor beggar clad in rags.
triumphant.zh: 因此，他回来时没有穿着凯旋国王的衣服，而是伪装成一个衣衫褴褛的穷乞丐。

triumphant.en: His plan was straightforward and audacious: travel into uncharted territory, gather fresh evidence, and come out triumphant—maybe with gold, maybe with tales of a living civilisation beyond the scope of imagination.
triumphant.zh: 他的计划直接而大胆：深入未知的领土，收集新的证据，然后凯旋而归——也许带着黄金，也许带着超越想象力的活文明的故事。

triumphant.en: And I think that the lack of glory, the lack of certainty, it makes it it turns it from worthwhile majesty into it's it's not even sufficiently triumphant to be called sad like it's just like weak and pissy and you have no idea if anything's going to work but what's the alternative entropy is going to come and fucking get you so what's the alternative.
triumphant.zh: 我认为缺乏荣耀，缺乏确定性，它使它从值得的威严变成了——它甚至不足以被称为悲伤，就像它只是软弱和烦躁，你根本不知道任何事情是否会奏效，但另一种选择是什么？熵会来找你，去他的，所以另一种选择是什么？

trait.en: DNA science showed that genes change over time, and those changes can create new traits.
trait.zh: DNA科学表明基因会随着时间改变，而这些改变可以创造出新的特征。

trait.en: Those with beneficial traits are more likely to pass them on shaping the species over time.
trait.zh: 那些拥有有益特征的个体更有可能将它们遗传下去，从而随着时间的推移塑造物种。

trait.en: And because tameness is a genetic trait, their puppies were even braver and even friendlier.
trait.zh: 而且由于温顺是一种基因特征，它们的小狗也就更加勇敢、更加友好。

trait.en: But you can still have the trait based on evidence rather than emotion.
trait.zh: 我认为这种证据框架一直以来——我的意思是，如果我有一个个人发展的北极星，那就是给自己证据。

trait.en: And I don't believe in binary traits, meaning like he's patient or he's impatient or he's loyal or he's disloyal.
trait.zh: 问题是：你有多忠诚？你有多诚实？

transfer.en: What they ended up developing was an early form of banking and international money transfer.
transfer.zh: 他们最终发展出的是早期的银行业和国际汇款业务。

transfer.en: In the late 1500s, the king decided to transfer the royal court from Kraków to Warsaw.
transfer.zh: 在 16 世纪末，国王决定将王廷从克拉科夫迁往华沙。

transfer.en: He wound up transferring to Columbia University, where he took a sociology course with a professor named Sudhir Venkatesh.
transfer.zh: 他最终转学到哥伦比亚大学，在那里他上了一门由苏迪尔·文卡特什（Sudhir Venkatesh）教授的社会学课程。

transfer.en: This means that learning how to ask better questions transfers directly into how effectively you can use AI tools.
transfer.zh: 这意味着，学会提出更好的问题可以直接转化为你使用AI工具的高效程度。

transfer.en: The skills you need to pass an exam, like writing an IELTS-style answer, probably doesn’t transfer to real-life communication.
transfer.zh: 通过考试所需的技能，比如写一篇雅思风格的答案，可能无法转化为现实生活中的沟通。

trousers.en: His trousers were torn to shreds, his arm was damaged, and his eardrum burst.
trousers.zh: 他的裤子被炸成了碎片，手臂受伤，耳膜破裂。

trousers.en: So the Australian police politely asked this man, Clive Mildoon, to pull down his trousers.
trousers.zh: 于是，澳大利亚警察礼貌地要求这个叫 Clive Mildoon 的男人脱下裤子。

trousers.en: There was a way, they had been told. Ask him to pull down his trousers, the British police instructed them.
trousers.zh: 英国警方指示说，有一个办法：让他脱下裤子。

tram.en: The Bee Network is an integrated public transport system that combines buses, trams, cycling, and walking.
tram.zh: 小蜜蜂网络是一个整合了公交、有轨电车、骑行和步行的公共交通系统。

tram.en: When he was the mayor of Manchester, his biggest creation was the Bee Network, that network that combined cycling and buses and trams and walking.
tram.zh: 当他担任曼彻斯特市长时，他最大的成就是创建了“小蜜蜂网络”，那个将骑行、公交、有轨电车和步行结合起来的网络。

tram.en: A few months ago, I was coming back from a swimming lesson with my son, and we, or rather I, accidentally left his favourite Spider-Man rucksack on the tram.
tram.zh: 几个月前，我和儿子上完游泳课回来，我们——或者说是我——不小心把他的蜘蛛侠最爱双肩包落在了有轨电车上。

trim.en: Together, it makes up almost $7 trillion per year, and there was Musk claiming he could trim this to more like $5 trillion.
trim.zh: 加起来每年将近 7 万亿美元，而 Musk 却声称他能将其削减到接近 5 万亿美元。

trim.en: Critics pointed out that these cuts weren’t just about trimming fat; they were dismantling programs that supported vulnerable populations, both at home and abroad.
trim.zh: 批评人士指出，这些削减不仅仅是为了去除赘肉；它们正在拆除那些支持国内外弱势群体的项目。

trivial.en: It's not a trivial thing to bring a frontier technology to most people, and that has not been done for many technologies.
trivial.zh: 把一项前沿技术带给大多数人，绝不是件小事，很多技术其实都没能做到这一点。

trivial.en: Now, it wasn’t, and still isn’t, particularly difficult to access the internet anonymously - there are plenty of ways of hiding your IP address and so on, so it’s fairly trivial to access a website anonymously.
trivial.zh: 在当时，乃至现在，匿名访问互联网并不是特别困难——有很多方法可以隐藏你的 IP 地址等等，所以匿名访问一个网站是相当容易的。

treaty.en: Next came the Treaty of Rome in 1957, which created the European Economic Community.
treaty.zh: 接下来是1957年的《罗马条约》，它创建了欧洲经济共同体。

treaty.en: Fighting continued, but in 1783, the Treaty of Paris formally recognized the independence of the United States.
treaty.zh: 战斗仍在继续，但在1783年，《巴黎条约》正式承认了美国的独立。

treaty.en: The result was The Treaty of Lausanne, which was signed in 1923.
treaty.zh: 其结果就是1923年签署的《洛桑条约》（The Treaty of Lausanne）。

treaty.en: The British defeated the French in North America, and the Treaty of Paris officially transferred New France to British control.
treaty.zh: 英国人在北美击败了法国人，《巴黎条约》正式将新法兰西划归英国管辖。

treaty.en: It replaced the humiliating Treaty of Sèvres and declared that it would recognise the independence of a new Republic of Turkey.
treaty.zh: 它取代了那个屈辱的《色佛尔条约》，并宣布承认新土耳其共和国的独立。

troublesome.en: Afterwards, I would go home on my bike, exhausted after 12 hours on my feet, serving drinkers who would sometimes get increasingly troublesome as the night went on.
troublesome.zh: 之后，我会骑自行车回家，站了 12 个小时后精疲力竭，还要招待那些随着夜色渐深有时会变得越来越难缠的酒客。

tremendous.en: It had a tremendous headstart. Unlike other political parties, it wasn’t starting from scratch.
tremendous.zh: 它有着巨大的领先优势。与其他政党不同，它不是从零开始的。

tremendous.en: And that required tremendous expenditures to maintain.
tremendous.zh: 而维持这样的殖民统治，需要耗费巨额的资金。

tremendous.en: And, Marty Cooper's story is tremendous.
tremendous.zh: 马蒂·库珀的故事非常精彩。

tremendous.en: Of course it takes tremendous amounts of time and effort and, for lack of a more scientific word, stick-to-itiveness, to make any real progress in the world.
tremendous.zh: 当然，要在世界上取得任何真正的进展，需要投入大量的时间、精力和——用一个不够科学的词来说——坚持不懈的精神。

tremendous.en: I can't tell you how much, you know, my team, my family, my sister, my brothers, they're such tremendous fans of you because you have this wonderful blend of wisdom.
tremendous.zh: 我无法告诉你，你知道，我的团队、我的家人、我的姐妹、我的兄弟，他们是多么崇拜你，因为你有一种美妙的智慧融合。

tramp.en: He'd tramp through mosquito infested jungles with bundles of maps and a theodolite, a type of instrument used for surveying territory and measuring angles.
tramp.zh: 他会背着一捆捆地图和经纬仪——一种用于勘测地形和测量角度的仪器，跋涉在蚊虫肆虐的丛林中。

trench.en: But when we were in the trenches, there was none of that.
trench.zh: 但当我们身处战壕时，根本没有那些东西。

trench.en: What they had found was part of what we now call the Mariana Trench, the deepest ocean trench in the world.
trench.zh: 他们发现的是我们现在所说的马里亚纳海沟（Mariana Trench）的一部分，这是世界上最深的海洋海沟。

trench.en: What they had found was part of what we now call the Mariana Trench, the deepest ocean trench in the world.
trench.zh: 他们发现的是我们现在所说的马里亚纳海沟（Mariana Trench）的一部分，这是世界上最深的海洋海沟。

trench.en: If I was a fly on the wall on the worst day in the trenches, is there a day that springs to mind?
trench.zh: 如果我是战壕里最糟糕日子里的一只苍蝇，有什么日子浮现在脑海吗？

trench.en: He was probably right. He returned to Britain, traded his machete and compass for an officer’s uniform, and headed into the trenches of northern France.
trench.zh: 他可能没想错。他返回英国，脱下砍刀和指南针，换上军官制服，一头扎进了法国北部战壕的泥潭中。

truck.en: You made many more of them by yourself. You drove the trucks.
truck.zh: 你独自制造了更多。你开了卡车。

truck.en: Is that a truck? What are they? Huh? Is something wrong?
truck.zh: 那是卡车吗？他们是什么？嗯？有什么不对劲吗？

truck.en: And I mean, loan officers would have an accountant that they could call up and say, can you write a statement saying that a truck driver can make this much money, or whatever.
truck.zh: 我的意思是，贷款专员会有一个可以随时打电话的会计，说：“你能写一份声明，证明一个卡车司机能赚这么多钱，诸如此类的话吗？”

truck.en: Nuclear power stations would have no ugly black smoke coming out of the top, there would be no dusty coal trucks driving in and out of the plant every day, there would just be harmless water vapour coming out of a large chimney.
truck.zh: 核电站顶部不会冒出难看的黑烟，没有满载灰尘的运煤卡车每天进出电厂，高大的烟囱里只会冒出无害的水蒸气。

truck.en: Obviously, there is the problem of how to get all of the equipment there, so it simply wouldn’t be possible to boost large trucks and heavy equipment into space, and anyhow, this kind of equipment would probably be of little use on an asteroid.
truck.zh: 显而易见，首先面临的是如何把所有设备运到那里的问题，将大型卡车和重型设备运推上太空是根本不可能实现的，而且无论如何，这类设备在小行星上可能也没多大用处。

triple.en: And when I'm putting in triple shifts is when I know I'm really gassing it.
triple.zh: 当我开启三倍轮班时，我就知道我真的在全力以赴了。

triple.en: The exam was full of double, sometimes even triple, negative questions.
triple.zh: 考试中充满了双重否定，有时甚至是三重否定题。

triple.en: My triple shift is I go to dinner and I come back at 7.30 and then I work from 7.30 until 11.30 or 1 or whatever.
triple.zh: 我的“三倍轮班”是指我吃完晚饭，7点半回来，然后从7点半一直工作到11点半或1点，或者随便什么时候。

triple.en: Everyday people were hit too—drivers in the United States and Europe suddenly found themselves paying double, triple the price to fill up their tanks, if they could even find petrol.
triple.zh: 普通老百姓也受到了冲击——美国和欧洲的司机突然发现，他们的油箱加满油要支付双倍、三倍的价格，如果他们还能买到汽油的话。

triple.en: Now, no offence to any wonderful people living in Turkey, Slovakia or Romania, but the GDP per capita of the UK is more than double that of Slovakia, triple that of Romania and four times that of Turkey, so given the wealth that exists in the country, the health outcomes for citizens should be better.
triple.zh: 无意冒犯生活在土耳其、斯洛伐克或罗马尼亚的优秀人民，但英国的人均 GDP 是斯洛伐克的两倍多、罗马尼亚的三倍、土耳其的四倍，因此鉴于该国的财富水平，国民的健康状况本应更好才是。

trunk.en: Stonehouse was in his swimming trunks, he had handed his clothes to an attendant, and waded out into the crystal clear water.
trunk.zh: Stonehouse 穿着泳裤，把衣服交给了一名服务员，然后走进了清澈见底的海水中。

transit.en: The bribes resulted in Siemens getting contracts for telecommunications networks in Nigeria, power grids in Israel, transit systems in Venezuela, and medical equipment in Russia.
transit.zh: 这些贿赂让西门子拿到了尼日利亚电信网络、以色列电网、委内瑞拉交通系统以及俄罗斯医疗设备的合同。

treason.en: The delegates who signed this document were effectively committing treason against the British Crown.
treason.zh: 签署这份文件的代表实际上是在犯下针对英国王室的叛国罪。

translation.en: And, we'll be using the Fagles translation, but there are many others to choose from.
translation.zh: 我们会采用费格尔斯的译本，不过市面上还有很多其他译本可供选择。

translation.en: It’s used in medicine, translation, customer service, research, and creative industries.
translation.zh: 它被用于医学、翻译、客户服务、研究和创意产业。

translation.en: I’ve read The Tale of Genji. There are lots of translations out there if you’re interested in checking it out.
translation.zh: 我读过《源氏物语》。如果你有兴趣了解它，有很多翻译版本可供选择。

translation.en: One reason these books became so successful is translation.
translation.zh: 这些书之所以能取得如此巨大的成功，原因之一就是翻译。

translation.en: They solve translation. They solve transcription.
translation.zh: 它们解决了翻译。它们解决了转录。

triangle.en: It is a tiny triangle of land floating alone in a massive blue space.
triangle.zh: 它是一小片孤零零地漂浮在广阔蓝色虚空中的三角形陆地。

triangle.en: By around the year 1000, Polynesians had settled islands across what is called the Polynesian Triangle.
triangle.zh: 大约在公元1000年左右，波利尼西亚人已经在被称为波利尼西亚三角区的各个岛屿上定居。

tribute.en: These groups often resented the more powerful Aztecs because they were forced to pay heavy tributes, like taxes, and sometimes even provide people for human sacrifices.
tribute.zh: 这些群体通常对更加强大的阿兹特克人满怀怨恨，因为他们被迫缴纳沉重的贡赋（比如赋税），有时甚至还要提供活人用于祭祀。

transistor.en: And, so, going from the vacuum tube to the transistor was one of these discontinuities.
transistor.zh: 所以，从真空管过渡到晶体管，正是这样一种断层式的跃迁。

transistor.en: But, the transistor itself was useless. You can't do anything with a transistor, right?-- Yeah.
transistor.zh: 但晶体管本身其实毫无用处。单靠一个晶体管你什么都做不了，对吧？——是啊。

tremendously.en: So, to see--to discover--as a young Bengali at Wharton in the readings of the writings of Adam Smith, to see Bengal reflected and celebrated was tremendously empowering for Iqbal.
tremendously.zh: 所以，作为一名在沃顿商学院求学的年轻孟加拉人，能在亚当·斯密的著作里读到、发现孟加拉的形象被反映出来，甚至被赞颂，这对伊克巴尔来说是极大的鼓舞。

transcend.en: Who are the most famous people in human history? uh there uh you know there there are people who sort of transcended the self the buddhas and the jesus's and the muhammad's of the world who else is famous uh the artists are famous you know art lasts for a long time the scientists are famous they discover a thing the conquerors are famous presumably because they conquered for their tribe there was someone that they were fighting for so generally the higher up you rise by doing things for greater and greater groups of people even though it may be considered tyrannical or negative, like, you know, Genghis Khan is famous, but to the Mongols, he was doing good, to the rest of them, not so much.
transcend.zh: 人类历史上最有名的人是谁？呃，你知道，有一些超越自我的人，比如这个世界的佛陀、耶稣和穆罕默德。还有谁有名呢？艺术家很有名，你知道艺术可以流传很久；科学家很有名，他们发现了一个事物；征服者很有名，大概是因为他们为自己的部落去征服，有他们为之战斗的人。所以，总体来说，你通过为越来越庞大的人群做事而不断晋升，尽管这可能被认为是暴政或负面的，就像成吉思汗很有名，但对蒙古人来说他在做好事，对其他人来说就没那么好了。

transient.en: Everything that comes and goes in the middle, including your mind, including your body, is unreal. and trying to find stability in those transient things is your castle that you're building on sand that's going to crumble.
transient.zh: 中间来来去去的一切，包括你的头脑、你的身体，都是不真实的。试图在那些短暂的事物中寻找稳定性，就像你在沙滩上建造城堡，最终会崩塌。

triumph.en: It was the triumph of data over common sense.
triumph.zh: 这是数据对常识的胜利。
